CS501 Machine Learning — Assignment 3

Topic: Gradient Descent Optimization

In this assignment, you will implement stochastic gradient descent (SGD)
and its variants (Adam, AdaGrad) from scratch using NumPy.

Part 1: Implement vanilla SGD and test on a 2D regression problem.
Part 2: Implement Adam optimizer and compare convergence.
Part 3: Write a short report comparing the optimizers.

This assignment is due on May 10, 2026.

Submission: Upload your code and report to Drexel Learn.
Points: 100 (code 70, report 30)
